c.tagline: France's pink-brick 'Ville Rose', home of Airbus and the stars.

taxi.fareNote: Official taxis run on the meter with a rooftop 'TAXI' sign; a night, Sunday, and airport surcharge applies. Booking by app or phone is common as street hailing is limited outside ranks.

emergency.note: 112 works Europe-wide; 17 reaches the police and 15 the medical SAMU service directly.

avoid.reason: Pickpocketing/petty crime around Matabiau station and some peripheral areas

hood_desc: The monumental heart of the city around the grand Place du Capitole and its city hall, ringed by shops, brasseries, and the Basilica of Saint-Sernin nearby; best for first-timers wanting everything walkable.
A chic, tightly-woven quarter of pink-brick lanes, antique shops, the covered Marché des Carmes, and some of Toulouse's best restaurants; suits foodies and design-minded travellers.
The lively left bank across the Garonne, an arty, bohemian district with the Les Abattoirs modern-art museum, markets, and an easygoing local feel; good for a less touristy stay.
The riverside student quarter around Place Saint-Pierre, famous for its packed bar terraces and late-night crowd along the Garonne; the go-to base for nightlife.
The elegant, quieter cathedral district of grand hôtels particuliers, antique dealers, and leafy squares; suits travellers who want a calm, upscale corner of the centre.
lodging: La Cour des Consuls Hôtel & Spa

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink throughout France.

transit.pay: A single Tisséo ticket is about €1.80 and a day pass around €6.80, sold at metro machines and tabac shops; the rechargeable Pastel card and contactless bank-card tap-in also work across metro, tram, and bus. The driverless VAL metro has two lines that intersect the whole network.
transit.hours: The metro runs roughly 5:15am to midnight, extended until around 3am on Friday and Saturday nights; buses run into the evening with weekend Noctambus night lines.

transit.m: Tram T2 to the city (Palais de Justice), ~30-40 min
Tisséo airport shuttle bus to Matabiau/centre, ~20-30 min

tip.r: Service is included by law ('service compris'); leaving a euro or two or rounding up for good service is a nice gesture but never required.
